registration_status: frozen before any Z17 model score or portfolio result was generated

hypothesis.definition: Cluster stocks from strictly prior behavior and train a rank Ridge on stock open-to-close return minus its same-date peer-group mean.
hypothesis.prediction: Peer-relative training targets isolate idiosyncratic continuation from common group moves.

authority.economic_acceptance_rule: none; report the preregistered result without selecting, tuning, or promoting it

time_design.fold_rule: for score month m, all model fitting, profile estimation, scaling, and clustering use rows dated from training_start through the last exchange date before m

peer_model.interpretation_of_eight_peers: exactly eight mutually exclusive peer groups, encoded as integer labels 0 through 7
peer_model.profile_history_mask: training_start <= date < fold score start and price_training_eligible is true
peer_model.qualified_profile: a code must have at least 20 historical rows on which all six profile features are finite; its six-dimensional profile is the arithmetic mean over those complete rows

fit.scaler: StandardScaler() fit across qualified code profiles

peer_model.low_history_or_missing_profile_fallback: For an unqualified code, compute each feature mean from all finite values in its historical profile-mask rows. Fill absent feature means with the corresponding arithmetic mean across qualified code profiles, transform with the frozen scaler, and assign the nearest frozen KMeans centroid by Euclidean distance. A code with no finite historical profile values therefore uses the all-global profile and its nearest centroid.
peer_model.assignment_scope: assign every code appearing in the fold's model-training or scoring rows to exactly one frozen peer group
peer_model.training_peer_mean: Within each training date and frozen peer group, arithmetic mean open-to-close return of other price_training_eligible observed stocks; the focal stock is excluded.
peer_model.peer_outcome_fallback: If the focal row has no other observed member in its peer group that date, use the same-date arithmetic mean of all other price_training_eligible observed stocks. If that global leave-one-out mean is unavailable, fail closed.
peer_model.fold_fixed_note: The score-fold clustering is fixed once from all information available before that score month and is applied to every historical target row in that fold.

predictive_model.training_rows: fold history with price_training_eligible true, observed finite open-to-close return, and a finite peer-residual target
predictive_model.raw_target: stock open-to-close return minus fold-fixed same-date leave-one-out peer mean
predictive_model.sample_weights: inverse number of model-training rows on that date, so every training date has total weight exactly one

portfolio.score_session_grid: all 266 expected panel sessions in the score period
portfolio.unfilled_or_unobserved_slot: cash with zero return and zero cost; no lower-ranked replacement
portfolio.cost_formula: an observed executed slot subtracts cost_bps/100 percentage points before fixed sleeve weighting

required_reporting.overall: mean daily net return at 20, 40, and 60 bps for top1 and top2
required_reporting.monthly: 13 calendar-month mean daily returns at each of 20, 40, and 60 bps
required_reporting.best20_removed: remove the 20 highest daily net20 portfolio returns and report the remaining mean net20
required_reporting.top10_profit_codes_cash: rank codes by cumulative fixed-sleeve net20 contribution, replace every slot in the ten highest codes with cash without replacement, preserve every date and portfolio denominator, and report mean net20
required_reporting.concentration: selected unique codes and top-10 selection share

integrity_tests.target_day_outcome_mutation: Within every fold, deterministically replace score-month oc_return_pct and label values, predict again from the untouched feature columns with the already fitted model, and require exact model scores and exact top1/top2 code/rank selections.
point_in_time: panel feature_source_max_date is strictly before date for every model-training and scoring row
each fold's maximum profile/model-training date is strictly before its minimum scoring date
each cluster profile row is strictly before its score-fold start
all eight peer labels are occupied in every fold
every fitted date has total sample weight one
integrity_tests.independent_pnl: recompute every daily top1/top2 return in a separate explicit date-and-slot loop and require agreement with the primary vectorized calculation within 1e-12 percentage points
integrity_tests.fail_closed: On any input hash/schema mismatch, infeasible eight-group clustering, unavailable leave-one-out fallback, nonfinite model score, missing expected score session, mutation failure, point-in-time failure, or P&L mismatch, emit no economic result and exit nonzero.
